metadata.description: Agent-agnostic skills for research, writing, review, and orchestration.

plugins.name: web-tool-routing
plugins.description: Web tool routing, detection, and fallback chains for any skill that accesses websites. Provides credit-aware tool selection.

plugins.name: prompt-creator
plugins.description: Prompt engineering best practices from Anthropic and OpenAI docs. Crafts effective prompts for any LLM.

plugins.name: prompt-74
plugins.description: High-stakes prompt engineering methodology for real-world decisions and deep research. Generates structured, evidence-driven prompts using the PROMPT-74 framework.

plugins.name: web-research
plugins.description: Web research methodology with wave-based execution, query strategies, and structured output.

plugins.name: competitor-research
plugins.description: Research competitors by gathering and analyzing community feedback from Reddit, forums, and review sites.

plugins.name: researching-consumer-goods
plugins.description: Researches consumer products for purchase across global markets. Compares prices, checks availability, finds deals.

plugins.name: writing-well
plugins.description: Applies Zinsser's nonfiction writing principles — simplicity, clarity, active voice, clutter elimination — to any text.

plugins.name: plan-review
plugins.description: Reviews implementation plans and code changes with structured technical analysis across architecture, code quality, testing, performance, and risk.

plugins.name: harness-protocol
plugins.description: Runtime-neutral Orchestrator → Developer → Verifier → Auditor harness for multi-sprint / multi-file work. Supports Claude/Superpowers and Codex subagent adapters. Generator never self-evaluates; Auditor scores against typed Vn assertions from a Validation Contract authored before any code. Project-agnostic.

plugins.name: go
plugins.description: End-to-end feature pipeline: plan → Validation Contract → harness protocol → plan-review → independent audit → execute → simplify → final audit. Runs inside an isolated git worktree. Hard dependency on obra/superpowers. Project-agnostic.

plugins.name: quick
plugins.description: Single-task feature pipeline for 1-3 file changes. Plan → agent-task-briefs placement + in-place plan shaping → optional independent review → subagent-driven-development → done. Routes to /go when boundary triggers fire. Hard dependency on obra/superpowers. Project-agnostic.

plugins.name: agent-task-briefs
plugins.description: Invariant-first task briefs and runtime model-lane guidance for worker agents, scouts, reviewers, and verifier subagents. Project-agnostic.

plugins.name: devil-advocate
plugins.description: Adversarial independent reviewer — spawns a fresh-context sub-agent to attack a plan, PR, design, or RFC. Enforces attack-first stance, severity rubric (blocker / major / minor), concrete-edit requirement, anti-fabrication rule. Distinct from plan-review (which surveys). Use before high-blast-radius changes or when a plan 'feels fine but is important.'

plugins.name: retrospective
plugins.description: Structured project retrospective — mines agent sessions, audits git + plans, cross-checks epistemic layers, and can identify repeated workflows worth packaging as skills, custom agents, or automations. Claude/Codex-friendly and project-agnostic. Use for /retrospective, retro, look-backs, or workflow-packaging requests.

plugins.name: tasks-for-sonnet
plugins.description: Compatibility alias for agent-task-briefs. Resolves legacy tasks-for-sonnet triggers, Sonnet handoffs, and sonnet_eligible markers.
